fato_historico: 2015: A terrorist attack on a hotel in Al-Arish, Egypt, kills at least seven people and injures 12 others.
energia_do_dia: Today may invite a deep reflection on resilience and the power of human connection. As the stars align, consider how you can bring peace into your immediate environment. Though global events remind us of the fragility of life, you have the potential to build a sanctuary of kindness, grounding your Taurus energy in steady, unwavering compassion today.
frase_do_dia: Your gentle presence is a beacon of light in this beautiful, complex world.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual wisdom and the search for inner truth.
conselho: Nurture your physical space and share warmth with those who need it most today.
